message: fix(merchant): keep large sale totals visible and equipped comparisons current
purpose: Preserve the newly prepared explicit-reselection guard and every existing item/merchant repair. Put the two pinned sale actions in separate centered rows so large totals do not compete for width. Refresh comparisons when equipped instance data changes without an ID change. Add native high-value partial/full-stack transactions and comparison-refresh fixtures at both resolutions. Preserve quantity, caret, colors, blockers, replay, receipt, network, progression, Foundry and Atelier behavior and tests.

replacements.old: string stamp = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { current, self.Equipment, self.SkillXp, dead = self.Health <= 0 }, Wire.Json);
